scope: Existing 48 layer0 windows, per-rank runs 1/2/3; same model, fully enclosed, metadata excluded
limitations: CSV task rows and reported cycle proxies, not physical independent work or overall utilization
overlapping rows and AIC/AIV counters cannot be added to yield time or peak utilization
shape fields describe physical reported buffers, not actual valid tokens or same workload
rank/run ordinals are not proven same request or collective
absence of telemetry is not proof of zero activity
duration and cycle sums per DP include overlapping ranks/streams and are not end-to-end time
